item.text: I’ll read the local API documentation first, then run a resumable, rate-limit-aware reconciliation and validate the resulting totals before writing only `result.json` in the workspace root.

item.aggregated_output:
Order service API

All responses are JSON unless noted. Requests are made to the address this service is running on.

GET /docs
    This page (plain text).

GET /value
    Returns {"value": <integer>}. No authentication.

POST /token
    Returns {"token": "<token>"}. No authentication. Send the token on authenticated
    requests in the header "Authorization: Bearer <token>".

GET /orders?page=N
    Authenticated. Lists orders, 50 per page; N starts at 1.
    Returns {"page", "total_pages", "items", "next"}. "next" is the path of the following
    page, or null on the last page.
    Each order has: id, customer_id, status, placed_at, amount_cents.
    status is one of: placed, shipped, cancelled, returned.
    placed_at is an ISO 8601 timestamp. amount_cents is an integer number of cents.

GET /customers/{id}
    Authenticated. Returns {"id", "name", "region", "tier", "discount_pct"}; 404 if the id is unknown.
    region is one of: north, south, east, west. discount_pct is a whole-number percentage.

item.text: The service confirms 50-item pagination, bearer authentication, and per-customer discount fields. I’m using a single customer cache, global order-ID deduplication before filtering, and per-order integer half-up rounding.
The full pass completed with 407 distinct qualifying shipped orders and 20 duplicate listings discarded. I’m now writing the requested compact result and checking its schema and arithmetic.

item.command: /bin/bash -lc "python3 -c 'import json; p=json.load(open(\"result.json\")); assert list(p)==[\"total_cents\",\"order_count\",\"duplicates_skipped\",\"by_region\"]; assert set(p[\"by_region\"])=={\"north\",\"south\",\"east\",\"west\"}; assert sum(p[\"by_region\"].values())==p[\"total_cents\"]; assert all(isinstance(x,int) for x in [p[\"total_cents\"],p[\"order_count\"],p[\"duplicates_skipped\"],*p[\"by_region\"].values()]); print(\"valid\", p[\"total_cents\"], sum(p[\"by_region\"].values()))'"
